$comment: The release and commit of HouseCairn/housecairn each rule carried by the app was aligned on. Written by `python3 tool/web_alignment.py update`, checked on every pull request by `check` (docs/plan.md, Alignment with the web application). Never edit a commit by hand.

recurrence.how: tool/recurrence_vectors.py, run in the web environment of the commit (uv sync --frozen --no-dev, this Python); compared byte for byte

task_templates.how: copy of the web file; compared byte for byte

design_tokens.how: every token of the web file is in the app's file with the same value; the app may add its own

web_parity.how: measured by tool/web_parity.py in a browser at 390 x 844 on the demonstration data (a script cannot regenerate it); `check` compares the release and commit the file says it measured with this pin, so a pin moved by `update` after a change of the web files listed here makes `check` fail until the measure is taken again

budget.how: tool/budget_figures.py loads test/fixtures/budget_fixture.json into the web of the commit (uv sync --frozen --no-dev, this Python, a temporary SQLite database) and writes every budget figure; compared byte for byte, and test/budget_web_test.dart compares the app with it
